apps.versionDescription: Fixes HHN house waits disappearing when an unchanged posted wait has an older provider timestamp. Fresh house observations keep valid posted waits, including zero; missing, invalid, future-dated, failed and expired observations remain unavailable. HHN house feed health is independent of regular rides. The app can refresh houses from the same free ThemeParks.wiki provider when the server has omitted waits, with bounded requests and retry backoff. The compact Halloween layout and existing favorites/completion data are preserved. Update the existing PIVOT app with the same SideStore signing identity. Physical SideStore installation remains untested.

versions.localizedDescription: Fixes HHN house waits disappearing when an unchanged posted wait has an older provider timestamp. Fresh house observations keep valid posted waits, including zero; missing, invalid, future-dated, failed and expired observations remain unavailable. HHN house feed health is independent of regular rides. The app can refresh houses from the same free ThemeParks.wiki provider when the server has omitted waits, with bounded requests and retry backoff. The compact Halloween layout and existing favorites/completion data are preserved. Update the existing PIVOT app with the same SideStore signing identity. Halloween Horror Nights uses a smaller event card and a slim favorites progress strip so houses appear sooner. The moon icon and purple/amber theme remain, with readable event date, hours, ticket notice and Live/Preview/Saved labels. Existing favorites, completion, sorting and previous fixes are preserved. Update the existing PIVOT app using the same SideStore signing identity. Physical SideStore installation remains untested.

Halloween Horror Nights gets a clearer purple-and-amber layout, larger wait numbers, readable house statuses, search, and All houses/Favorites/To do filters. A favorite-house checklist tracks your night; existing favorites, sorting and completed houses are preserved. Preview, saved and unavailable data have distinct labels, and stale or missing waits stay unknown. Large text layouts and touch targets were checked in the iPhone simulator. This native update includes the previous 1.14.1 fixes and preserves the existing app and Live Activity identity. Keep PIVOT installed and update it using the same SideStore signing identity. Physical SideStore installation remains untested.

Saved lightning observations now expire and clearly show saved or unavailable data. Empty or unhealthy ride feeds no longer report that all rides are clear. Failed refresh status stays saved when switching parks, and delayed GPS results no longer override manual park choices. Existing 1.14 features, saved-data keys and the Live Activity extension are preserved. Native update only; backend changes are separate.
